title: Help make VocabX better
text: VocabX is still very young, and your impressions decide what it becomes next.
inviteTitle: Level {level} already — you know VocabX inside out!
inviteText: You have got to know the app well, so your opinion matters especially now. Spare a minute — it will help the development enormously.
valuable: Every piece of feedback is incredibly valuable to us: we read everything ourselves, and your answers decide what we improve and add first.
anonymous: Everything is sent anonymously: no name, e-mail or IP address is collected — only your answers, the interface language and your level.
bugTextPlaceholder: What you did and what you saw instead of what you expected
emptyText: Please write at least a few words.

survey.title: Short survey
survey.text: 4 ratings and a few words — about a minute. Helps the most.

bug.title: Found a bug?
bug.text: Something not working right? Tell us where — we will fix it.
bug.label: Bug description
bug.placeholder: What you did, what happened and what should have happened

review.title: Short review
review.text: A few sentences about your impressions of VocabX.
review.label: Your review
review.placeholder: What do you like, and what not?

idea.title: Suggest an idea
idea.text: What are you missing? The best ideas make it into the next versions.
idea.label: Your idea
idea.placeholder: It would be great if VocabX…

survey.text: Just 4 ratings from 1 to 5 — takes about a minute. Thank you for helping!

questions.overall: How do you like VocabX overall?
questions.ease: How easy is it to use?
questions.usefulness: How well does it help you remember words?
questions.motivation: How much do you want to come back every day?

survey.noteLabel: Describe in a couple of words what you did not like
survey.notePlaceholder: For example: too few words, confusing menu
survey.commentLabel: What would you improve or add?
survey.missing: Please rate every item — it is just a few taps.

errorSend: Could not send. Check your connection and try again — your answers are still in the form.
errorRate: Too much feedback in a short time. Please try again a little later.

thanks.title: Thank you so much!
thanks.text: Your feedback is in. Answers like yours are what make VocabX better — you have just done a lot for it.
